'''Mind Shard''' or a '''mind twist'''<ref name="Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: The Prisoner of Bogan'' 1]]</ref> was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to mentally splinter an opponent's mind, wracking the victim with pain. This might cause an opponent to lose their focus on a Force power and cause it to dissipate.<ref name="DLOTS2" /> Jedi Master Durron used a psychic blast to stagger other Jedi on Hapes during the Yuuzhan Vong War.<ref>''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Journey|New Jedi Order: Dark Journey]]''</ref>

[[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] wrote that this was a helpful power for a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to learn.<ref name="BOS" />
